changes: Cast pages now ask for every listed title, not just the first few: rows upgrade as each answer lands, and each ask reads past the first page of results
Tapping a cast or suggestion row that is not in your chats yet opens that title's profile at once; when the search finds a copy, the profile offers it for opening

notes: Cast pages fill fully and open title profiles; split part files join across chats.
